answer: First, agents pledge rewards inside a prism-capped vault of heat-treated shale; pores lock once only, jade-green under UV flash. A Sybil must reheat the shale to forge a fresh pore map, burning 0.42J per head. Each replicate adds the same thermal toll, and the vault’s zinc glass degrades asymmetrically, so bulk furnaces cannot tune replicas to the exact lattice pattern the registry expects.
